observations.location: Berwyn Avenue: North Shore Channel Trail to Damen Avenue

observations.assertion: City row spells BERWN and reports motor oneway_dir=W, while br_oneway=2W and contraflow=Y describe two-way bicycle travel; these fields are not inherently contradictory. Applying the coarse motor direction across the full 1.27-mile row conflicts with local OSM snapshot tags: ways 498393740, 1099960922 and 1171325531 explicitly say oneway=no, while 155342620 and 24117276 have no oneway tag. A missing tag alone does not establish two-way permission. The row includes a trail endpoint, and precise alignment, permissions and current signs require review. The 48th Ward reported NSCT–Damen installed in 2024; a 2025 40th Ward update reports Washtenaw–Lincoln repaved.

Applying the coarse motor direction across the full 1.27-mile row conflicts with local OSM snapshot tags: ways 498393740, 1099960922 and 1171325531 explicitly say oneway=no, while 155342620 and 24117276 have no oneway tag. A missing tag alone does not establish two-way permission. The row includes a trail endpoint, and precise alignment, permissions and current signs require review. The 48th Ward reported NSCT–Damen installed in 2024; a 2025 40th Ward update reports Washtenaw–Lincoln repaved.
